facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Peter was in bed. His sisters were happy. They went outside. His sisters went out.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The next morning, Peter was still sick in bed. But his three sisters were feeling very happy. Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail always listened to Mother. His sisters went out for a walk down the lane. Peter watched from his window and felt a little sad. He wished he had been a good rabbit like them.
facts.Word cards: sisters = 자매들 / went = 갔다 / good = 착한 / lane = 오솔길 🆕
